studio.window_subtitle: Create validated, game-ready mod content using guided forms, live JSON preview, and automatic EN+RU localization stubs.
studio.status_valid: Valid — ready to save to your mod workspace.
studio.status_invalid: Fix the highlighted errors before saving.
studio.cat.event_desc: Create a scripted geopolitical dilemma with triggers, two choices, and national effects.
studio.cat.decision_desc: Create a repeatable or structural national decision with political capital and GDP costs.
studio.cat.modifier_desc: Create a timed national modifier affecting economy, military, or domestic stability.
studio.cat.doctrine_desc: Create a grand strategic course with XP multipliers, political cost, and national bonuses.
studio.cat.disease_desc: Create a regional public health crisis with climate latitude band, spread rate, and mortality.
studio.cat.disaster_desc: Create a regional geological or weather disaster with instant damage and recovery rate.
studio.cat.localization_desc: Create paired English and Russian translation entries for your mod.
studio.help.id: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only (e.g. my_custom_event).
